findings.evidenceJa: 夜が明けようとしていた。
findings.governingReading: The night is about to break into dawn as Archer waits in the castle.

findings.highlight: It only stays in his body as knowledge.
findings.evidenceJa: 知識として大本に記録されるだけだ。
findings.governingReading: The event is registered only as knowledge in the underlying original; the summoned instance does not bodily retain it.
findings.explanation: Knowledge recorded in the original heroic-spirit source becomes knowledge stored in Archer’s body.

findings.highlight: I chose this place since I was told there would be no interruptions here.
findings.evidenceJa: 邪魔は入らんというから来てやったのだがな
findings.governingReading: He addresses the visitor: he came because he had been told no one would interfere; the speaker who supplied that assurance is not identified here.
findings.explanation: Archer says he came because he was promised no interruption, but English says he chose the place.

findings.highlight: Shinji Matou smiles and returns to the entrance.
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐慎二は入り口に振り返る。
findings.governingReading: He turns back to face the entrance, revealing the powerful figure supporting his boast; he does not walk back there in this sentence.
findings.explanation: Shinji turning toward the entrance becomes returning to it.

findings.evidenceJa: それは夜明けとともに消える。
findings.governingReading: Archer says the agreement lasts until dawn and disappears when dawn comes, after which Shinji may do as he likes.
findings.explanation: The no-harm agreement expiring with dawn becomes expiring sometime by dawn.
